property: The model has one assertion, checked in every cycle: !rst -> (!(chosen & chosen_not_popped & (lookup_id == chosen_push_id)) || (|lookup_match)). I.e. a CAM id that was pushed and never popped since must be found by lookup.
mem_havoc: The cam array is flattened into registers (the 8 entries are slices of cam); abstract_state on cam, cam_valid or entity_cnt is an entry havoc.
